specification.xy_registration: X guide and one-sided -Y cover stop; +Y releases
specification.assembly_instruction: Lower at Y+2.4, slide toward -Y to the datum ends, align the four bottom screws, then tighten evenly. The one-sided Y datum touches at nominal Y=0; it is not an interference fit.
specification.tolerance_limit: The current LCD interface already fouls at +X0.19 mm. The left 0.15 mm clearance needs a resin fit trial; it must not be widened without another optical-interface review.
